description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various analysis methods used in a study on deep reasoning in speech, audio, music, and their mix. The chart is divided into several slices, each representing a different method. The largest slice, accounting for 40.4% of the analysis, is labeled 'Perception Layer'. The second largest slice, representing 41.2%, is labeled 'Semantic Layer'. The third largest slice, at 14.1%, is labeled 'Cultural Layer'. The remaining slices are smaller and include 'Spatial Analysis', 'Temporal Analysis', 'Correlation Analysis', 'Music Theory', 'Counting & Statistics', 'Environmental Perception & Reasoning', 'Emotion & Intention Analysis', 'Speaker Analysis', 'Anomaly Detection Signal Analysis', 'Acoustic Quality Analysis', 'Imaginary', 'Culture of Speaker', and 'Aesthetic Analysis'. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way. The slices are ordered in descending size, starting with the 'Perception Layer' and ending with 'Aesthetic Analysis'.
